name: booth
note: The 40-50 minute Act 1 + Act 2 run. Every step waits on the module; the cues are for the presenter, not for the driver. The medallion and its 608 bearing are this run's, never the table's.

brief.text: Build The Perch: a clip-on articulated arm that holds an ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 at eye level, with a cradle head. I'll edit the clamp myself. Plan: Clamp_Base (unassigned), Shoulder_Hub -> lead-claude, Arm_Proximal + Arm_Distal -> arm-opencode, Cradle_Base (unassigned), Cradle_Lid -> lid-creao. Look up the ESP32-S3 with lookup_board and use its measured Params. Two printable arm segments joined by M4 screws and heat-set inserts, a 608 bearing at the shoulder, a dovetail head mount. Both USB-C ports must be reachable. Every part must fit a 180 mm bed and follow our walls and fits. The distal arm is what we'll simulate and lighten.

gate.if_missed: Forty minutes in, no part has started. Stop the build, say so, and run the smaller job in table-safe.json.

steps.label: Act 1's brief is typed in the panel
steps.say: The cold open: sponsor window first, then this brief.

steps.label: The planner looks the board up
steps.say: Board Params fill from the library; the Elastic card shows the board.

steps.label: The plan's tasks appear with named owners
steps.say: Clamp_Base and Cradle_Base stay unassigned: a host worker takes them.

steps.label: A request on the held distal arm is refused

steer.body: thicken Arm_Distal by 2 mm; it flexes.

steps.say: The lock is the rule: the holder's part is not yours to change.

steps.label: All six Act 1 parts are in the model
steps.say: Build. The Creao trace is one call per turn; the Claude workers take the clamp and cradle.

steps.label: arm_reach is steered to 160 mm
steps.say: One shared size; every part bound to it recomputes and the owners are told.

steps.label: Auto-constrain is previewed and applied
steps.say: Tools > Auto-constrain: alias, pattern and fit proposals; apply, then tol_press_fit = -0.08 mm.

steps.label: The FEA report is published
steps.say: 4.9 N at the head, fixed at the elbow, PETG; the report pops for the whole team.

steps.label: The killed Creao helper is taken over
steps.say: Kill the bridge, wait for stale, then ask lead-claude to take the lid over.

steps.label: The clamp handoff is accepted
steps.say: Sam holds the clamp, edits the M8 pocket, and hands it to base-claude with the note.

steps.label: Round 1 comes back with findings
steps.say: Droid's pointer and trace; the three findings go to tasks.

steps.label: The lid wall is corrected and the rules are added
steps.say: 2.4 mm wall by hand, then Learned design style: the three rules.

steps.label: Round 2 is approved
steps.say: The Factory card says approved; that is the quality gate.

steps.label: The lattice report is published
steps.say: 90% stiffness, gyroid, 5 mm cells, held at the elbow: the verifier console and mass saved.

steps.label: STEP and STL are exported
steps.say: Print-ready on a 180 mm bed; nothing is printed here.

steps.label: The design doc and the lessons are in Kibana
steps.say: cadswarm-designs, the Workflow execution, and the lessons that Act 2 will recall.

steps.label: Act 1 closes on the sponsor window
steps.say: Leave the window up, restart Creao, and hand the phone to Sam for Act 2.

steps.label: Act 2's planner recalls both designs
steps.say: From Sam's phone: the second head starts by recalling the first one, its problems and its lessons.
